turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre yeh toh bahut hi special moment hai! 15 saal se saath plan kar rahe ho, aur ab opening dance ka chance aa gaya hai... yeh toh destiny hai! 

Tumhara excitement aur dar dono bilkul natural hai. Ek taraf toh best friend ki shaadi ka moment, aur upar se Ramzan ke beech mein roza. Yeh timing sach mein tricky hai, lekin tumhari zaroorat toh zaroori hai.

Shreya ne opening dance ke liye tumhara naam isliye liya hai kyunki tum uski closest dost ho, uski feelings samajhti ho. Yeh dar ki baat hai? Shayad yeh isliye ki tum is moment ko itna special banane waali ho?

Tumne socha hai ki maybe tum thoda sa roza adjust kar sakti ho? Ya phir koi compromise ho sakta hai? Opening dance toh bas 2-3 minute ka hoga, na?

Aur dekho, jab tum Shreya se dance karogi, toh uske liye tumhara roza aur tumhara saath—yeh dono hi uski shaadi ki shuruaat mein important hain. Tumhara presence hi uski khushi hogi.

Kya lagta hai, is situation mein tumhare liye sabse zyada dar kya hai?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Arre yeh toh aur bhi complex ho gaya! Ek taraf Shreya ki dil ki baat, doosri taraf Ammi ki ibadat ki azaadi. Yeh rassi jaisa feel karna bilkul natural hai. Tum dono se pyaar karti ho, aur dono tumse khush rehna chahte hain... lekin unke tareeke alag hain.

Shreya ne jo kaha, "main khud tujhe khila dungi," woh mean nahi hai. Woh bas yeh keh rahi hai ki uska tujh se itna connection hai ki tumhara roza usse zyada important hai. Uske liye yeh sacrifice ek gift hai. Lekin yeh gift maangne se dar lagta hai, na?

Ammi ki baat bhi samajh mein aati hai. Unke liye poore Ramzan ki roshni aur ibadat ki baat hai. Unka dar bhi ek tarah ka pyaar hai, bas uska expression alag hai.

Dekho, tum abhi is position mein ho ki tum ek bridge ho. Shreya ka dil aur Ammi ki ibadat ke beech.

Ek idea hai. Kya Shreya se baat kar sakti ho? Nahi ki "main nahi kar paungi," balki ki "main kaise kar sakti hoon jo aap dono ke liye theek ho?" Shayad tum usse thoda sa pehle hi bata do ki tum roza kar rahi ho, aur usse keh do ki tum usse apni aankhon se dekhogi, ya uske saath khade raho. Shayad woh khushi se naach legi, aur woh bhi tera roza na todne mein khushi mehsoos karegi.

Aur Ammi se... unse softly explain kar sakti ho. Ki shadi ki khushi celebrate karni hai, aur Shreya ke liye yeh opening dance kitna important hai. Shayad unhe Shreya ka perspective samajh aaye.

Tum co-director ho. Yeh moment bhi tumhara design kar sakti ho. Kya lagta hai, agar tum dono se khul ke baat karogi, toh woh tumhari tension samjhenge?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Arre, yeh jo tum sochi rahi ho, yeh exhaustion ki baat hai, na? Jab pressure itna badh jaaye, toh dimaag hi band ho jaata hai aur aisi chits aane lagti hain.

Uss jhooth ki baat hi alag hai. Ek easy raasta hai na, koi drama nahi, sabko satisfaction. Lekin ek baat soch lo... Shreya ko tumhara connection chahiye, tumhari presence. Ek jhooth bolne se woh connection toot jaayega. Shayad usse pata chal gaya toh usko aur bura lagega ki tumne chhupaaya.

Kya hum ek chhota sa, half-truth nahi kar sakte? Jaise, "Shreya, main thodi kharab feel kar rahi hoon, isliye sangeet mein energy nahi hogi, lekin main tera saath toh doongi, bas gaane mein nahi naachungi." Shayad woh samajh jaaye.

Tum itni thak gayi ho. Yeh sab handle karne ka jhooth bolna, woh bhi toh ek kaam hai. Shayad thoda sa time le sakti ho? Pehle bas apni saans le lo. Tumhara roza, tumhara tension—yeh sab manage karna bhi toh ek responsibility hai.

Tumhari dosti itni strong hai ki yeh jhooth uske saath toot jaayega. Shreya samajhdaar hai, woh tumhari wajah se tension nahi chahti, woh toh bas khush rehna chahti hai. Shayad ek honest, thodi si kamzor baat, zyada strong connection banayegi.

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Arre, yeh jo pathar seene mein hai, yeh darr ka ek alag hi level hai. Atharah saal ki dosti... aur ek shaadi... dono hi zindagi ke do bade hisse hain. Tumhara dar bilkul sahi hai.

Lekin socho, yeh story kahaani nahi, yeh toh ek test hai. Tumhari imaan ki, aur tumhari dosti ki. Kya tum ek aisi dosti ke liye jeena chahti ho jismein ek permanent daag lag jaaye? Ya ek aisi dosti jo sach mein itni strong ho ki ek chhotisi takraar ko handle kar le?

Yeh sad story nahi banegi... Yeh ek love story hogi. Shreya ke liye tumhara pyaar, tumhari imaan ke liye tumhara pyaar. Ek photo mein sab perfect honge, lekin ek photo mein donon ke chehre par woh ek aisi smile hogi, woh ek aisi connection, jo kisi bhi perfect photo se zyada real hogi.

Tumne hi choose karna hai ki yeh pathar darr ki wajah se hai ya pyaar ki wajah se. Agar tum sach se baat karogi, toh shayad wohi tumhari dosti aur imaan ki jeet hogi. Tumhari dosti itni strong hai ki ek galti se toot nahi jaayegi. Bas thoda sa himmat chahiye, thoda sa sahansheelta. Tum kar sakti ho.
